statements.t: The Company’s lead lipid nanoparticle (LNP)-based in vivo CAR-T candidate, TPST-4003 combines a clinically supported dual-targeting CD19/BCMA CAR structure with an advanced CD7-targeting delivery platform to support broad immune reset across multiple indications.
